decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial line builds directly on the firm's core formulation know-how and supplier base, and its own page signals strategic commitment. The firm can readily interpret early results and refine the line in-house, so it should stay.

A hyaluronic acid serum is a close extension of the firm's natural facial care expertise and uses well-understood ingredients. The integrated development and production capability lets the firm assimilate customer feedback and improve it rather than drop it.
A cleansing milk is a staple that complements the existing facial range and draws fully on existing know-how. Small-batch in-house production means low cost to keep it while learning from results.
